description:
Is this Solana token a rug or safe to buy? Binary safety verdict — call it before buying or paying for any Solana meme token. Returns verdict SAFE / RISKY / RUG / UNKNOWN, action ENTER_OK / CAUTION / SKIP, confidence, specific red flags (active mint/freeze authority, dev dump, sell pressure, whale distribution, thin liquidity) and measured signals (unique wallets, buy share, bonding-curve liquidity, graduation status). Unknown mint returns UNKNOWN, never "safe". REST: GET /api/v1/solana/mint/{mint}/rug-check ($0.02).

Args:
    mint: Solana token mint address
name: mint_rug_check
title: Solana rug check
